paragraphs.label: Μέρος Αʹ — Ὁ Ἰησοῦς (Part A — Jesus)
paragraphs.translation: After a little time a certain woman comes from the village toward the spring. She has a water jar and comes in order to draw water from the spring.

translations.es: Después de un momento llega una mujer del pueblo hacia el manantial. Tiene un cántaro para sacar agua.
translations.pl: Po chwili kobieta przychodzi z wioski ku źródłu. Ma dzban do czerpania wody.
translations.fil: Pagkatapos ng ilang sandali ay may babaeng nagmula sa nayon patungo sa bukal. May tapayan siya para sa pagkuha ng tubig.

paragraphs.translation: Jacob rises up and greets her: "Peace to you, O woman. I am very thirsty, I and my donkey. But I have no water jar to draw the water. Are you able to draw water for us from the spring?"

translations.es: Jacob se levanta y la saluda: 'Paz a ti, O mujer. Tengo mucha sed, yo y mi asno.'
translations.pl: Jakub wstaje i pozdrawia ją: «Pokój tobie, O kobieto. Jestem bardzo spragniony, ja i mój osioł.»
translations.fil: Bumangon si Jacob at binati siya: 'Kapayapaan sa iyo, O babae. Nauuhaw na ako nang husto, ako at ang aking asno.'

paragraphs.translation: The woman says to him: "Peace to you, O man. I am able to draw water for you."

translations.es: La mujer le dice: 'Paz a ti, O hombre. Puedo sacar agua para ti.'
translations.pl: Kobieta mówi do niego: «Pokój tobie, O mężczyzno. Mogę czerpać dla ciebie wodę.»
translations.fil: Sinabi ng babae sa kanya: 'Kapayapaan sa iyo, O lalaki. Makapagkukuha ako ng tubig para sa iyo.'

paragraphs.translation: So then the woman draws water in her jar and provides the water to Jacob so that he may drink.

translations.es: Así que la mujer saca agua en su cántaro y da el agua a Jacob para que beba.
translations.pl: Kobieta czerpie więc wodę w swoim dzbanie i daje wodę Jakubowi, aby pił.
translations.fil: Kaya kumukuha ang babae ng tubig sa kanyang tapayan at ibinibigay ang tubig kay Jacob para uminom.

paragraphs.translation: "I give thanks to you, O woman," says Jacob to her. Then he drinks the water and provides it to the donkey so that he too may drink.

translations.es: 'Te doy gracias, O mujer,' dice Jacob a ella. Luego bebe el agua y se alegra.
translations.pl: «Dziękuję ci, O kobieto,» mówi do niej Jakub. Potem pije wodę i cieszy się.
translations.fil: 'Nagpapasalamat ako sa iyo, O babae,' sabi ni Jacob sa kanya. Pagkatapos uminom siya ng tubig at nagagalak.

paragraphs.translation: After this, "What is your name?" says the woman.

translations.es: Después de esto, '¿Cuál es tu nombre?' dice la mujer.
translations.pl: Po tym: «Jak masz na imię?» mówi kobieta.
translations.fil: Pagkatapos nito, 'Ano ang iyong pangalan?' sabi ng babae.

paragraphs.translation: He answers: "My name is Jacob. And what is your name?"

translations.es: Él responde: 'Mi nombre es Jacob. ¿Y cuál es tu nombre?'
translations.pl: On odpowiada: «Moje imię to Jakub. A jak ty masz na imię?»
translations.fil: Sumasagot siya: 'Jacob ang pangalan ko. At ano ang pangalan mo?'

paragraphs.translation: She says to him: "My name is Salome."

translations.es: Ella le dice: 'Mi nombre es Salomé.'
translations.pl: Ona mówi do niego: «Moje imię to Salome.»
translations.fil: Sinabi niya sa kanya: 'Salome ang pangalan ko.'

paragraphs.translation: Then again Jacob opens his mouth and says to her: "I give thanks to you, O Salome, because you provide water to me so that I may drink and not be thirsty. Now my body is no longer hungry nor thirsty. For whenever a person is hungry, he eats bread; and whenever he is thirsty, he drinks water. For bread is the food of the body and water is the drink of the body. But I know another food and another drink; this is the food and drink of the spirit. The person has both body and spirit. With the body we eat bread and drink water; but with the spirit we know God and worship him."

translations.es: Entonces Jacob le dice: 'Te doy gracias, O Salomé. Dios es bueno.' Salomé lo escucha.
translations.pl: Potem Jakub mówi do niej: «Dziękuję ci, O Salome. Bóg jest dobry.» Salome słucha go.
translations.fil: Pagkatapos sinabi ni Jacob sa kanya: 'Nagpapasalamat ako sa iyo, O Salome. Ang Diyos ay mabuti.' Nakikinig si Salome sa kanya.

paragraphs.translation: Salome marvels and says to him: "What are you saying? I do not know these words."

translations.es: Salomé se maravilla y le dice: '¿Qué estás diciendo? No conozco estas palabras.'
translations.pl: Salome dziwi się i mówi do niego: «Co mówisz? Nie znam tych słów.»
translations.fil: Namumangha si Salome at sinabi sa kanya: 'Ano ang sinasabi mo? Hindi ko alam ang mga salitang ito.'

paragraphs.translation: He says to her: "Yes, I say to you: God is not like the sun or the earth. For he has no body. God is spirit. And we worship him in spirit and in truth. If a person worships God in spirit, God hears him. This is the will of God."

translations.es: Él le dice: 'Sí, te digo: Dios no es como el sol ni la tierra. Pues es espíritu y verdad.'
translations.pl: On mówi do niej: «Tak, mówię ci: Bóg nie jest jak słońce ani ziemia. Jest bowiem duchem i prawdą.»
translations.fil: Sinabi niya sa kanya: 'Oo, sinasabi ko sa iyo: ang Diyos ay hindi tulad ng araw o lupa. Espiritu at katotohanan kasi siya.'

paragraphs.translation: Salome says to him: "I know the God of Abraham and of Isaac and of Jacob."

translations.es: Salomé le dice: 'Conozco al Dios de Abraham, de Isaac y de Jacob.'
translations.pl: Salome mówi do niego: «Znam Boga Abrahama, Izaaka i Jakuba.»
translations.fil: Sinabi ni Salome sa kanya: 'Kilala ko ang Diyos ni Abraham at ni Isaac at ni Jacob.'

paragraphs.translation: He says to her: "And I also believe in God, who is the God of Abraham and Isaac and Jacob. But Jesus is the Son of God. For this reason I also believe in Jesus."

translations.es: Él le dice: 'Y yo también creo en Dios, que es el Dios de Abraham, de Isaac y de Jacob.'
translations.pl: On mówi do niej: «I ja też wierzę w Boga, który jest Bogiem Abrahama, Izaaka i Jakuba.»
translations.fil: Sinabi niya sa kanya: 'At naniniwala rin ako sa Diyos, na siyang Diyos ni Abraham at Isaac at Jacob.'

paragraphs.translation: Salome says to him: "Now I know that you are a Christian. I know the God of Abraham and of Isaac and of Jacob. And I believe in God, but I do not know Jesus nor do I believe in Jesus."

translations.es: Salomé le dice: 'Ahora sé que eres cristiano. Conozco al Dios de Abraham.'
translations.pl: Salome mówi do niego: «Teraz wiem, że jesteś chrześcijaninem. Znam Boga Abrahama.»
translations.fil: Sinabi ni Salome sa kanya: 'Ngayon alam ko na ikaw ay Kristiyano. Kilala ko ang Diyos ni Abraham.'

paragraphs.translation: Jacob says to her: "Yes, I am a Christian; for this reason I believe in Jesus. And I love Jesus; and I follow Jesus; and I hear his voice. For Jesus is the Christ. Not only this, but Jesus is the bread of life, who provides the water of life. Whoever drinks this water will no longer be thirsty, and whoever comes to him will no longer be hungry, because he himself is the bread of life."

translations.es: Jacob le dice: 'Sí, soy cristiano; por eso creo en Jesús. Y Jesús es el Hijo de Dios.'
translations.pl: Jakub mówi do niej: «Tak, jestem chrześcijaninem; dlatego wierzę w Jezusa. A Jezus jest Synem Bożym.»
translations.fil: Sinabi ni Jacob sa kanya: 'Oo, Kristiyano ako; kaya naniniwala ako kay Hesus. At si Hesus ang Anak ng Diyos.'

paragraphs.translation: Salome marvels and still listens to the words of Jacob.

translations.es: Salomé se maravilla y aún escucha las palabras de Jacob.
translations.pl: Salome dziwi się i wciąż słucha słów Jakuba.
translations.fil: Namumangha si Salome at nakikinig pa rin siya sa mga salita ni Jacob.

paragraphs.translation: Jacob says: "And Jesus is the way and the truth and the life; no one comes to God except through him. God is in Jesus and Jesus is in God. Whoever believes in Jesus also believes in God, and whoever follows Jesus also follows God. There are two ways, one of life and one of death. And Jesus is the way of life."

translations.es: Jacob dice: 'Y Jesús es el camino y la verdad y la vida; nadie viene al Padre sino por Él.'
translations.pl: Jakub mówi: «A Jezus jest drogą i prawdą i życiem; nikt nie przychodzi do Ojca, jak tylko przez Niego.»
translations.fil: Sinabi ni Jacob: 'At si Hesus ang daan at ang katotohanan at ang buhay; walang sinuman ang pumupunta sa Ama maliban sa pamamagitan Niya.'

paragraphs.translation: Salome is still silent and says nothing. Jacob sees the fields and trees around the spring, and sees a vine near the spring. The vine has branches, and the branches bear fruit.

translations.es: Salomé aún está callada y no dice nada. Jacob ve los campos y los árboles alrededor.
translations.pl: Salome wciąż milczy i nic nie mówi. Jakub widzi pola i drzewa wokół.
translations.fil: Tumatahimik pa rin si Salome at walang sinasabi. Nakikita ni Jacob ang mga bukid at mga puno sa paligid.

paragraphs.translation: He says therefore to Salome: "Do you see that vine, which is near the spring? The vine has branches. If a branch remains in the vine, it bears much fruit. But if it does not remain in the vine, it is not able to bear fruit; for without the vine the branch is nothing."

translations.es: Dice entonces a Salomé: '¿Ves esa vid, que está cerca del manantial? La vid es hermosa.'
translations.pl: Mówi więc do Salome: «Czy widzisz tę winorośl, która jest blisko źródła? Winorośl jest piękna.»
translations.fil: Sinabi niya kung gayon kay Salome: 'Nakikita mo ba ang ubas na iyon, na malapit sa bukal? Maganda ang ubas.'

paragraphs.translation: "In the same way Jesus also is the true vine and his Father is the farmer, and we Christians are like his branches. If we remain in Jesus, we bear much fruit. But if we do not remain in him, we are not able to do anything; for without him we are not able to bear fruit, just as a branch without the vine."

translations.es: 'Del mismo modo Jesús también es la verdadera vid y su Padre es el agricultor, y nosotros somos las ramas de la vid.'
translations.pl: «W ten sam sposób Jezus jest prawdziwą winoroślem, a jego Ojciec jest rolnikiem, a my jesteśmy gałęziami winorośli.»
translations.fil: 'Gayon din si Hesus ang tunay na ubas at ang kanyang Ama ang magsasaka, at tayo ang mga sanga ng ubas.'

paragraphs.translation: "God, who is the Father of Jesus and ours, loves his Son, and the Son loves us. His love, which is great, remains in us if we believe and follow him. And not only do we love God, but we ought to love one another."

translations.es: 'Dios, que es el Padre de Jesús y nuestro, ama a su Hijo, y el Hijo nos ama. Y Jesús dice: permanezcan en mi amor.'
translations.pl: «Bóg, który jest Ojcem Jezusa i naszym, kocha swojego Syna, a Syn nas kocha. I Jezus mówi: trwajcie w mojej miłości.»
translations.fil: 'Ang Diyos, na siyang Ama ni Hesus at atin, ay nagmamahal sa kanyang Anak, at ang Anak ay nagmamahal sa atin. At sinasabi ni Hesus: manatili kayo sa aking pagmamahal.'

paragraphs.translation: "God is love, and whoever remains in love remains in God, and God remains in him. If we love one another, God remains in us and his love. And there is no fear in love, but perfect love casts out fear." "If anyone says 'I love God' and hates his brother, he is a liar; we ought to love brothers and sisters."

translations.es: 'Dios es amor, y quien permanece en el amor permanece en Dios, y Dios permanece en él.'
translations.pl: «Bóg jest miłością, i kto trwa w miłości, trwa w Bogu, a Bóg trwa w nim.»
translations.fil: 'Ang Diyos ay pag-ibig, at ang sinumang nananatili sa pag-ibig ay nananatili sa Diyos, at ang Diyos ay nananatili sa kanya.'

paragraphs.translation: "And this is the commandment, which is the will of God: that we love one another. Whenever we love one another, we remain in the love of God. And whenever we remain in his love, there is great joy in our hearts."

translations.es: 'Y este es el mandamiento, que es la voluntad de Dios: que nos amemos unos a otros.'
translations.pl: «I to jest przykazanie, które jest wolą Bożą: abyśmy miłowali jeden drugiego.»
translations.fil: 'At ito ang utos, na siyang kalooban ng Diyos: na mahalin natin ang isa't isa.'

paragraphs.translation: "If we do this commandment, Jesus says that we are his friends, not servants. Jesus calls us friends. For the servant who works in the field does not know what his master does; but the friend knows. Jesus wants us to know him and his will and his work."

translations.es: 'Si cumplimos este mandamiento, Jesús dice que somos sus amigos, no siervos.'
translations.pl: «Jeśli spełniamy to przykazanie, Jezus mówi, że jesteśmy jego przyjaciółmi, a nie sługami.»
translations.fil: 'Kung ginagawa natin ang utos na ito, sinasabi ni Hesus na tayo ang kanyang mga kaibigan, hindi mga lingkod.'

paragraphs.translation: Salome hears all these words. She is silent with her mouth; but the words of Jacob stir up her heart. And she wants to know more.

translations.es: Salomé oye todas estas palabras. Está callada de boca; pero las palabras de Jacob toman su corazón.
translations.pl: Salome słyszy wszystkie te słowa. Milczy ustami; ale słowa Jakuba biorą jej serce.
translations.fil: Narinig ni Salome ang lahat ng salitang ito. Tumatahimik ang kanyang bibig; ngunit kinukuha ng mga salita ni Jacob ang kanyang puso.

paragraphs.label: Μέρος Βʹ — Ὁ Ἰησοῦς; (Part B — Jesus?)
paragraphs.translation: After a little while Salome opens her mouth and says to Jacob: "You speak many things about Jesus, O man. But who is this Jesus? I want to know more."

translations.es: Después de un momento Salomé abre su boca y dice a Jacob: 'Dices muchas cosas grandes, O Jacob.'
translations.pl: Po chwili Salome otwiera usta i mówi do Jakuba: «Mówisz wiele wielkich rzeczy, O Jakubie.»
translations.fil: Pagkatapos ng ilang sandali, binuksan ni Salome ang kanyang bibig at sinabi kay Jacob: 'Marami kang sinasabing malalaking bagay, O Jacob.'

paragraphs.translation: Jacob greatly rejoices in his heart because Salome wants to hear. He says therefore to her: "Yes, O Salome, I say again to you so that you may know. Jesus is the Son of God, who is the Christ. He himself is the way and the truth and the life. No one comes to God the Father except through Jesus. And he himself is the bread of life; whoever believes in him will no longer be hungry nor thirsty forever."

translations.es: Jacob se alegra mucho en su corazón porque Salomé quiere escuchar. Dice entonces: '¿Ves ese pastor y sus ovejas?'
translations.pl: Jakub bardzo się cieszy w sercu, bo Salome chce słuchać. Mówi więc: «Czy widzisz tego pasterza i jego owce?»
translations.fil: Lubos na nagagalak si Jacob sa kanyang puso dahil gusto ni Salome na makinig. Sinabi niya kung gayon: 'Nakikita mo ba ang pastol na iyon at ang kanyang mga tupa?'

paragraphs.translation: On the road near the spring are the shepherd and the sheep. The shepherd leads the sheep. The sheep follow him. Jacob sees the sheep which eat the grass in the field. He also sees the shepherd who leads and guards them. He says therefore to Salome:

translations.es: En el camino cerca del manantial están el pastor y las ovejas. El pastor guía a las ovejas.
translations.pl: Na drodze blisko źródła są pasterz i owce. Pasterz prowadzi owce.
translations.fil: Sa daan malapit sa bukal ay ang pastol at ang mga tupa. Inaaakay ng pastol ang mga tupa.

paragraphs.translation: "Do you see these sheep, which eat the grass? And do you see the shepherd who guards them? Jesus is the good shepherd. The good shepherd knows his sheep, and the sheep know the voice of the shepherd. The good shepherd lays down his life on behalf of the sheep; he does not flee when the wolf comes, but remains and guards and saves them. In the same way Jesus also lays down his life on behalf of us, because he loves us. We are his sheep, and he himself is our shepherd."

translations.es: '¿Ves estas ovejas, que comen la hierba? ¿Y ves al pastor que guarda a las ovejas?'
translations.pl: «Czy widzisz te owce, które jedzą trawę? I czy widzisz pasterza, który strzeże owiec?»
translations.fil: 'Nakikita mo ba ang mga tupang ito, na kumakain ng damo? At nakikita mo ba ang pastol na nagbabantay ng mga tupa?'

paragraphs.translation: "But the hired worker is not like the good shepherd; the sheep are not his, therefore when the wolf comes, he sees the wolf and abandons the sheep and flees. The wolf therefore seizes them and scatters them. This happens because he is a hireling and does not love the sheep as the good shepherd does."

translations.es: 'Pero el jornalero no es como el buen pastor; las ovejas no son suyas, por eso cuando ve al lobo, huye.'
translations.pl: «Ale najemnik nie jest jak dobry pasterz; owce nie są jego, dlatego gdy widzi wilka, ucieka.»
translations.fil: 'Ngunit ang manggagawa ay hindi tulad ng mabuting pastol; hindi kanya ang mga tupa, kaya kapag nakita niya ang lobo, tumakas siya.'

paragraphs.translation: "Not only is Jesus the good shepherd, but also the door of the sheep. Whoever enters through Jesus — that is, through the door — Jesus saves. And the person has eternal life."

translations.es: 'Jesús no solo es el buen pastor, sino también la puerta de las ovejas. Quien entra por la puerta es salvo.'
translations.pl: «Jezus nie tylko jest dobrym pasterzem, ale też drzwiami owiec. Kto wchodzi przez drzwi, jest zbawiony.»
translations.fil: 'Hindi lamang si Hesus ang mabuting pastol, kundi pati na rin ang pintuan ng mga tupa. Ang sinumang pumapasok sa pintuan ay naliligtas.'

paragraphs.translation: Salome listens and says: "These are good words. But you say that Jesus lays down his life on behalf of us. Why does he do this?"

translations.es: Salomé escucha y dice: 'Estas son buenas palabras. Pero dices que Jesús da su vida por las ovejas. ¿Por qué?'
translations.pl: Salome słucha i mówi: «To są dobre słowa. Ale mówisz, że Jezus oddaje swoje życie za owce. Dlaczego?»
translations.fil: Nakikinig si Salome at sinabi: 'Mabuting salita ito. Ngunit sinasabi mo na ibinibigay ni Hesus ang kanyang buhay para sa mga tupa. Bakit?'

paragraphs.translation: Jacob says to her: "Because of our sins, O Salome. For all people have sins. If we say that we have no sin, we deceive ourselves and the truth is not in us. But if we confess our sins, God, who is faithful and righteous, forgives us our sins and cleanses us from all unrighteousness. For the blood of Jesus, who is his Son, cleanses us from all sin. We are dead in our sins. Only Jesus is able to save us from our sins."

translations.es: Jacob le dice: 'Por nuestros pecados, O Salomé. Pues todos los hombres tienen pecados.'
translations.pl: Jakub mówi do niej: «Z powodu naszych grzechów, O Salome. Wszyscy ludzie mają bowiem grzechy.»
translations.fil: Sinabi ni Jacob sa kanya: 'Dahil sa ating mga kasalanan, O Salome. Lahat kasi ng tao ay may kasalanan.'

paragraphs.translation: Salome is silent and still listens. She sees the sheep and the shepherd in the field. Then she sees the light of the sun which comes through the tree.

translations.es: Salomé está callada y aún escucha. Ve a las ovejas y al pastor en el campo.
translations.pl: Salome milczy i wciąż słucha. Widzi owce i pasterza na polu.
translations.fil: Tumatahimik si Salome at nakikinig pa rin. Nakikita niya ang mga tupa at ang pastol sa bukid.

paragraphs.translation: Jacob speaks again: "And Jesus is the light of the world. For without Jesus, people are in darkness. And Jesus shows us the light. Whoever follows Jesus does not walk in darkness but walks in the light and has the light of life. For Jesus is light, and there is no darkness in him. And the light shines in the darkness and enlightens every person who comes into the world."

translations.es: Jacob habla de nuevo: 'Y Jesús es la luz del mundo. Pues sin Jesús, la gente camina en la oscuridad.'
translations.pl: Jakub mówi znowu: «A Jezus jest światłością świata. Bez Jezusa bowiem ludzie chodzą w ciemności.»
translations.fil: Nagsalita muli si Jacob: 'At si Hesus ang liwanag ng mundo. Kasi kung wala si Hesus, naglalakad ang mga tao sa kadiliman.'

paragraphs.translation: "If therefore we say that we have fellowship with God and we walk in darkness, we do not speak the truth. But if we walk in the light, just as God is in the light, we have fellowship with him and with one another, and the blood of Jesus cleanses us. For this is the commandment of God, which we hear always: that we love one another. Whoever loves his brother remains in the light; but whoever hates his brother is in the darkness."

translations.es: 'Si decimos que tenemos comunión con Dios y caminamos en la oscuridad, decimos una mentira.'
translations.pl: «Jeśli mówimy, że mamy wspólnotę z Bogiem, a chodzimy w ciemności, mówimy kłamstwo.»
translations.fil: 'Kung sinasabi natin na may pakikipag-ugnayan tayo sa Diyos at naglalakad tayo sa kadiliman, nagsisinungaling tayo.'

paragraphs.translation: Salome says: "You say these things about Jesus — that he is the bread, the shepherd, the light. But also life? How is he himself the life?"

translations.es: Salomé dice: 'Dices estas cosas sobre Jesús — que es el pan, el pastor, la luz.'
translations.pl: Salome mówi: «Mówisz te rzeczy o Jezusie — że jest chlebem, pasterzem, światłością.»
translations.fil: Sinabi ni Salome: 'Sinasabi mo ang mga bagay na ito tungkol kay Hesus — na siya ang tinapay, ang pastol, ang liwanag.'

paragraphs.translation: Jacob answers: "Yes, O Salome. Jesus is the resurrection and the life. Whoever believes in him lives, and lives forever. For God, who loves the world, gives his Son to us, so that a person who believes in him may not die but may have eternal life. Jesus therefore is the life and resurrection."

translations.es: Jacob responde: 'Sí, O Salomé. Jesús es la resurrección y la vida. Quien cree en Él, aunque muera, vivirá.'
translations.pl: Jakub odpowiada: «Tak, O Salome. Jezus jest zmartwychwstaniem i życiem. Kto w Niego wierzy, choćby umarł, żyć będzie.»
translations.fil: Sumasagot si Jacob: 'Oo, O Salome. Si Hesus ang muling pagkabuhay at ang buhay. Ang naniniwala sa Kanya, kahit mamatay, mabubuhay.'

paragraphs.translation: Salome looks at Jacob and says: "You speak many and great words, O Jacob. And your words are good. But I marvel greatly."

translations.es: Salomé mira a Jacob y dice: 'Dices muchas y grandes palabras, O Jacob. ¿Crees en todo esto?'
translations.pl: Salome patrzy na Jakuba i mówi: «Mówisz wiele i wielkie słowa, O Jakubie. Czy wierzysz w to wszystko?»
translations.fil: Tinitingnan ni Salome si Jacob at sinabi: 'Marami at malalaking salita ang sinasabi mo, O Jacob. Naniniwala ka ba sa lahat ng ito?'

paragraphs.translation: Salome is silent again. But the sun still shines greatly; her water jar is still beside the spring, and the water is still in it. But Salome does not worry about the water of the jar; she thinks about the water of life.

translations.es: Salomé está callada de nuevo. El sol ya no brilla con fuerza; pues se acerca la tarde.
translations.pl: Salome milczy znowu. Słońce już nie świeci mocno; zbliża się bowiem wieczór.
translations.fil: Tumatahimik muli si Salome. Hindi na napakalakas ng sikat ng araw; papalapit na kasi ang gabi.
